title: Nisnevich induction principle for quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: An algebraic space cannot be covered by affine Zariski opens, so the scheme induction principle does not suffice. The proof uses a finite scheme-stratified etale filtration and refines each stage into elementary distinguished squares with affine chart, showing that all overlap objects meet the inductive hypotheses.
